logical_identity: primary_scan_id plus exploratory_selection_rank; all selected ON targets may be HIP98505

own_score_provenance.recovered_original_DC_free_hypothesis: Authenticate the corrected exhaustive original-grid output and exact selected channel/drift/width/score. Its original cached map_pin is parent provenance; the original DC-touched cached maximum is never the expected new own score.
own_score_provenance.original_clean_cached_carrier_maximum: Authenticate the original map's selected carrier maximum and its channel/drift/width tuple.
own_score_provenance.direct_context_vs_prefix_score: Compare the fixed direct-cell context score to the correct authoritative selected score within the frozen context tolerance. Prefix arithmetic establishes the corrected winner; direct-cell arithmetic is retained for consistency with prior fixed contexts. A matching context score is not a new detector optimization.

raw_geometry_identity: Exact width and all six16-row rounded absolute source-channel center vectors. Use saved baseline vectors, retaining their original provenance.
normalized_geometry_identity: Same raw geometry plus exact original physical4096 native_chunk_index/core_q. Preserve legacy JSON encoding including the raw_geometry_id field. Reuse additionally requires matching immutable per-context full16 normalization terms, source row/file pins and same original preprocessing contract.
normalization_term_identity: Binary64 identity of all16 row_power_median, row_residual_median, row_winsorized_residual_location and row_residual_MAD_scale terms, sixteen unmasked counts4096, and exact physical core interval. Distinct JSON container paths do not imply distinct measurements.
conditional_query_rule: After revised TOP3 is frozen, metadata-derive all six center vectors and exact reuse keys. Import each matching prior physical profile by byte-hash provenance. Evaluate six fixed profiles only for each genuinely new normalized physical template. Never count repeated logical references as independent measurements.

profile_schema.selected_profiles: Wrappers containing template_id, selected_original_record, physical_template_id, raw_geometry_id, context_scan_id, transported times, source_fixed_profile, query_disposition and exact baseline/source score provenance.
profile_schema.new_physical_profiles: Direct records with canonical_selected_original_record, all16 centers/times/row box sums/contributions/cells, fixed score, DC contacts, raw503 pin and original-domain normalization pin.
profile_schema.own_per_carrier_score_checks: Each names the typed authoritative source, expected score/tuple, actual own fixed score and difference; recovered checks also retain original parent map provenance separately.

fixed_reference_rule: Own scan uses the exact original arange16*TSAMP vector. Transport uses(context.tstart-origin.tstart)*86400 plus that original vector; do not fit new time, frequency, drift or width.
new_query_preprocessing: Original full16 physical4096 core,4000 halo,median501,nearest original crop edges and original MAD/location rule. Prefer exact pinned same-core norms/crops; preserve each genuinely new12096 crop and raw503 capsule once.
propagated_DC_contacts: Annotate contacts in every context without a new veto or reranking.
